subject: Dedicated GPU fleet sizing & procurement timeline for Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@titan-oem.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-health.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Titan OEM - initial quote & lead times for Aurelia Health Dedicated Fleet

Hi Dev / Marissa,

Thanks for the RFQ. Attached is our initial equipment quote (Titan_Quote_0426.pdf) and a short lead-time summary. Key points:
- Baseline configuration: 6x Titan-HX 80GB cards (NVLink-enabled), 3U chassis, dual PSU, standard racked and cabled.
- Typical lead time: 12–16 weeks from PO acceptance.
- Expedited path: 8–10 weeks with air freight + priority assembly (15% surcharge + expedited logistics).
- Power / cooling req: 40kW per rack (estimate) — please confirm datacenter PDU capacity.
- Optional managed install and burn-in service: +2 weeks on-site.

We flagged available production slots for June/July builds but inventory is first-come. If you're exploring a hybrid model (on-prem + cloud burst), we can coordinate early to ensure compatibility of chassis and NVLink topologies for later scale.

Attached: Titan_Quote_0426.pdf

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the BOM.

Best,
Alice Kim
Enterprise Sales - Titan OEM
alice.kim@titan-oem.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@titan-oem.com>, procurement@aurelia-health.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Titan OEM - initial quote & lead times for Aurelia Health Dedicated Fleet

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and the quote. A few clarifying questions before we circulate internally:
1) Can you break out the expedited surcharge by hardware vs logistics vs service? We need line items for Aurelia's procurement team.
2) Do you have a sample rack PDU/load sheet we can share with Aurelia's facilities?
3) Will the quoted NVLink topology require specific motherboard SKUs we should lock?

Marissa — see the attached Titan quote. For our sizing ask: can you confirm the initial prod target (tokens/sec, concurrency, 95p latency target) so Karthik can validate whether 6x 80GB is sufficient or if we should plan for 8x to avoid early regen?

Karthik / Neha — we may need a parallel cloud-reserve option. Karthik, any visibility on provider-side reservations for Q3?

Next step idea: Marissa to send target workload numbers, Titan to provide PO-ready quote (line items + expedited breakdown), Karthik to provide cloud-reserve feasibility. Aim to have a mutual action plan we can share with Aurelia by 2026-05-07.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Head of Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Titan OEM - initial quote & lead times for Aurelia Health Dedicated Fleet

Folks — quick note from cloud capacity side (pulled AWS + partner data):
- AWS (us-west-2) has constrained availability for GPU-reserved instances that match Titan-HX equivalent through July; reservation lead (marketplace/backorder) can push to Aug.
- Marketplace reserved capacity is possible but requires 6–9 week lead for marketplace contract + 2–4 weeks for infra allocation once vendor confirms.
- Colossus Cloud partner (cc: capacity-ops@colossuscloud.com) has a partner pool that can provide burstable capacity earlier (subject to contract) — we should evaluate cost delta vs Titan expedited hardware.
- Risk: if Aurelia needs production-in-place by mid-Sept, hardware PO needs to be signed by ~June 1 (12–14 week build + ship + install). For expedited 8–10 week route, PO no later than Jun 15 to meet Sept targets.

Attached note: AWS_capacity_note.txt (short summary). Recommend parallel track: (A) secure OEM PO for baseline 6 units now, (B) reserve partner cloud pool for initial weeks post-launch to cover any shortfalls while additional hardware ships.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-health.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Titan OEM - initial quote & lead times for Aurelia Health Dedicated Fleet

Thanks — adding the Aurelia workload ask and an initial mutual action plan (high level):
Workload assumptions (Aurelia):
- 95th latency target: 1200ms for chat completions (p50 ~ 180ms).
- Sustained tokens/month (estimate): 45M tokens (generation + prompt).
- Concurrency target: 180 active sessions peak.
- Safety buffer: x1.5 for burst window.
Sizing recommendation:
- Prod baseline: 6x Titan-HX 80GB-equivalent (target to support beta + early prod).
- Ramp: +6 units in month 1 post-launch, +6 units by month 3 (total 18) in line with adoption curve.
MAP (mutual action plan) milestones:
1) 2026-05-07 — Redwood to provide MAP and final workload numbers to Aurelia (attached MAP_Aurelia_0504.xlsx).
2) 2026-05-15 — Aurelia signs SOW; procurement to issue PO.
3) 2026-06-01 — If PO executed, Titan build slot secured (12–16 weeks).
4) 2026-07-15 to 2026-08-15 — Staging and integration with Redwood (burn-in), cloud partner reserved for bursts.
5) 2026-09-15 — Target live date for baseline 6 units.
Questions / asks for vendors:
- Titan: please provide the line-item expedited breakdown and a separate rack/PDU power sheet.
- Colossus: can you confirm hourly burst rates and minimum booking window? (cc-ed)
- Aurelia procurement: confirm PO cadence and if they require fixed ship-to dates/supplemental insurance.

Appreciate quick turn — this is time sensitive for the Q3 launch.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product - Dedicated
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@titan-oem.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: capacity-ops@colossuscloud.com, procurement@aurelia-health.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 18:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Titan OEM - initial quote & lead times for Aurelia Health Dedicated Fleet

Marissa / Dev — appreciate the MAP. We've produced a revised quote with the requested line-item breakout and expedited-cost delta (Titan_Revised_Quote_0505.pdf). Highlights: 
- Standard: 12–16 weeks (line-item pricing as previously).
- Expedited: 8–10 weeks. Expedited split = +8% hardware assembly premium, +5% logistics uplift, +2% priority QA/service. Total surcharge: +15% (itemized in attachment).
- Rack/PDU: included a recommended PDU/circuit layout and load sheet (see attachment).
- Deposit terms: 30% on PO, remainder on ship.
We can hold an expedited build window if we receive PO and deposit by 2026-06-10. If Aurelia cannot meet that internal cadence, we recommend hybrid burst with Colossus for Sept go-live as Karthik suggested.

Next steps:
1) Dev / Marissa: confirm preference (standard vs expedited + deposit timing).
2) Neha / Aurelia procurement: advise PO timeline so we can lock build slot.
3) Karthik / Colossus: if hybrid, confirm minimum booking and rates.

Happy to set up a 30-min call with Aurelia procurement this week to walk the line items.

Best regards,
Alice Kim
Enterprise Sales - Titan OEM
